description_en: Queries the information about disks on a host
description_zh: 调用DescribeDedicatedHostDisks接口查询主机上的磁盘信息
name: DescribeDedicatedHostDisks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the host. You can log on to the ApsaraDB dedicated cluster console and view and obtain the host ID on the Hosts page
parameters.help_zh: 主机ID。您可以登录云数据库专属集群控制台，在主机列表查看并获取主机ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the host. You can log on to the ApsaraDB dedicated cluster console to view the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198326.html of the host
parameters.help_zh: 主机所在的地域ID。您可以登录云数据库专属集群控制台，查看主机所在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198326.html
parameters.name: region_id

Category.description_en:
The storage type of the host. Valid values:
cloud_ssd: local SSD
cloud_essd: ESSD
Category.description_zh:
主机存储类型，取值：
cloud_ssd：本地SSD盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘

DBInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance running on the disk

Device.description_en: The device name of the instance to which the cloud disk or local disk is mounted
Device.description_zh: 云盘或本地盘挂载实例的设备名

DiskId.description_en: The ID of the cloud disk or local disk

HasDBInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether an instance is running on the disk. Valid values:
true: An instance is running on the disk.
false: No instance is running on the disk
HasDBInstance.description_zh:
是否有实例运行在该磁盘上，取值：
true：有运行的实例
false：无运行的实例

MaxIOPS.description_en: The maximum IOPS of the disk. Unit: 10,000

MaxThroughput.description_en: The maximum throughput of the disk. Unit: MB/s
MaxThroughput.description_zh: 磁盘最大吞吐量，单位为MB/S

PerformanceLevel.description_en:
The performance level of the disk. 

MyBase provides three performance levels for cloud disks: ESSD, PL2 ESSD, and PL3 ESSD. A higher performance level (PL) indicates better cloud disk performance
PerformanceLevel.description_zh:
磁盘性能。 

MyBase提供了ESSD云盘、ESSD PL2云盘、ESSD PL3云盘三个性能级别的云盘规格，PL级别越高，云盘性能越好

Size.description_en: The size of the cloud disk or local disk. Unit: GB
Size.description_zh: 云盘或本地盘大小，单位为GB

Status.description_en:
The status of the cloud disk. Valid values:

In_use

Available

Attaching

Detaching

Creating

ReIniting
Status.description_zh:
云盘状态，取值：

In_use

Available

Attaching

Detaching

Creating

ReIniting

Type.description_en:
The type of the cloud disk or local disk. Valid values:

system: system cloud disk

data: data cloud disk
Type.description_zh:
云盘或本地盘磁盘类型 ，取值：

system：系统盘

data： 数据盘

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the cloud disk or local disk
ZoneId.description_zh: 云盘或本地盘所属的可用区ID
